If ⟦0⟧ locally admits a section over ⟦1⟧ (i.e. every ⟦2⟧ has an open neighbourhood ⟦3⟧ such that ⟦4⟧ has a section over ⟦5⟧), then the diagram
        ⟦6⟧
        (where ⟦7⟧) is exact.
the geometric fibres of ⟦0⟧ are integral.
⟦0⟧ is invertible at ⟦1⟧ (i.e. ⟦2⟧ is generated by a regular element of ⟦3⟧) and ⟦4⟧ is flat over ⟦5⟧ at ⟦6⟧.
⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ are flat over ⟦2⟧ at ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧ is a Cartier divisor on the fibre ⟦5⟧ at the point ⟦6⟧.
⟦0⟧ is flat over ⟦1⟧ at ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧ is generated by an element ⟦4⟧ that induces on ⟦5⟧ a non-zero divisor germ.
